item.description:
### Added - **Skip "finished" alerts for short turns.** Settings → Notifications → Finished alerts: Always, or only for turns of at least 10 s, 30 s or 1 min. It covers the Mac banner, the chime and the phone and watch alert. Always is the default. - **Mute one session.** Right-click a session and choose Mute Finished Alerts. Permission requests and questions still come through.
### Improved - Following a long Devin session from your iPhone uses much less work on your Mac.
